triamterene_soy lecithin_high_chelation_.why_it_matters: Potassium can rise too high, which may cause heart rhythm problems or muscle weakness.
how_to_fix_it: Limit high-potassium portions and ask your clinician whether potassium monitoring is needed.
Keep at least 2-3 hours between Soy Lecithin and triamterene.
